from lfx.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput
from lfx.io import (
    DropdownInput,
    FileInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    MultilineInput,
    Output,
)
from lfx.schema.image import get_file_paths
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.services.deps import get_settings_service
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)
from lfx.utils.file_path_security import (
    component_file_access_scopes,
    enforce_local_file_access,
    is_local_file_access_restricted,
)


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Ensure files is a list and filter out empty/None values
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        # Filter out None/empty values
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        # Build endpoints inject caller-controlled file references directly into
        # ChatInput. Resolve and validate local references before the Message can
        # later read them while constructing model attachment content.
        if files:
            settings_service = get_settings_service()
            storage_type = getattr(getattr(settings_service, "settings", None), "storage_type", "local")
            # The storage factory falls back to local storage for unsupported
            # values, so only the explicitly configured S3 backend may bypass
            # filesystem containment.
            if str(storage_type).lower() != "s3" and is_local_file_access_restricted():
                scope_ids = list(component_file_access_scopes(self))
                # Public executions replace graph.flow_id with a per-visitor
                # virtual ID. Only the server-populated source provenance may
                # restore the already-validated public attachment namespace.
                source_flow_id = getattr(self.graph, "source_flow_id", None)
                if source_flow_id:
                    scope_ids.append(source_flow_id)
                for file_path in get_file_paths(files):
                    enforce_local_file_access(file_path, scope_ids=scope_ids)

        session_id = self.session_id or self.graph.session_id or ""
        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
            context_id=self.context_id,
            files=files,
        )
        if session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

import json
from copy import deepcopy

from pydantic import ValidationError

from lfx.base.models.decisions.providers import unique_json_object
from lfx.base.models.decisions.runtime import decision_token_usage, evaluate_decision, request_variables_of
from lfx.base.models.decisions.schema import (
    DecisionBatchRequest,
    DecisionConfigurationError,
    DecisionQuestion,
    configuration_summary,
    decision_request,
    validation_summary,
)
from lfx.base.models.unified_models import handle_model_input_update
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import (
    DecisionQuestionsInput,
    FloatInput,
    HandleInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    ModelInput,
    MultilineInput,
    Output,
    TabInput,
)
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.message import Message

_KINDS = ("Choice", "Noul", "Score")
_FORM, _JSON = "Form", "JSON"
# Text fields a node held before the question list, which could be bound to a global variable.
_LEGACY_LABELS = {"question": "Question", "yes_description": "What Yes Means", "no_description": "What No Means"}
# Question X's text can be connected through the hidden field <prefix>X.
_CONNECTION_PREFIX = "question_input_"
# What Add question appends; a node starts with none.
_NEW_QUESTION = {
    "name": "",
    "kind": "Choice",
    "question": "",
    "options": [
        {"id": "a", "label": "Option A", "description": ""},
        {"id": "b", "label": "Option B", "description": ""},
    ],
    "levels": [
        {"id": "low", "label": "Low", "description": ""},
        {"id": "medium", "label": "Medium", "description": ""},
        {"id": "high", "label": "High", "description": ""},
    ],
    "yes_description": "",
    "no_description": "",
}

# What an agent learns about this component when it is a tool.
_RESULT_INFO = (
    "Answers the configured questions about the context and returns JSON. Several questions return an answers "
    "object keyed by question name, with shared usage counted once. Choice gives "
    "probabilities by option ID and, when the provider names one, selected_option (otherwise take the most "
    "probable option); Noul gives probability_true, the "
    "probability the answer is yes, from 0 to 1; Score gives score, from 0 (the first level) up to one less than "
    "the number of levels, and probabilities by level ID. confidence is the provider's own measure, not an "
    "option's probability."
)

# Follow-ups, deferred until there is demand:
# - Images: TypeSafe `assets` behind its TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images header, Perplexity image parts
#   in `state`, OpenAI image inputs. Needs size limits and SSRF checks for each format.
# - Pinned model versions, such as pplx-decider-v1.2: policy allows models by name, so each version
#   needs its own catalog and policy entry.


class DecisionModelComponent(Component):
    """Evaluates named judgments through the same runtime as the Smart Router."""

    display_name = "Decision Model"
    description = "Evaluate one or more choices, probabilities, or ordered scores"
    name = "DecisionModel"
    icon = "Split"

    inputs = [
        ModelInput(
            model_type="decision", name="model", display_name="Decision Model", required=True, real_time_refresh=True
        ),
        TabInput(
            name="question_mode",
            display_name="Questions Mode",
            options=[_FORM, _JSON],
            value=_FORM,
            real_time_refresh=True,
            info="Fill in the questions here, or paste Questions JSON. All questions share the same Context.",
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="questions_json",
            display_name="Questions JSON",
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
            value="",
            info="In JSON mode, paste an object keyed by question name. Each value uses kind (choice, noul, "
            "score), question, and options or levels as arrays of {id, label, description}. Noul descriptions "
            'are optional. Example: {"urgent":{"kind":"noul","question":"Is this urgent?"}}. '
            "This replaces the form for this run; its values are preserved.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context",
            display_name="Context",
            info="The text the questions are about, such as a message or a document.",
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        DecisionQuestionsInput(
            name="questions",
            display_name="Questions",
            value=[],
            new_question=_NEW_QUESTION,
            connection_prefix=_CONNECTION_PREFIX,
            info="Each question has its own Decision Type: Choice picks one option, Noul answers yes or no, and "
            "Score places the input on ordered levels. With more than one question, they are sent in one call and "
            "the result holds each answer under its Name, which defaults to q1, q2 and so on.",
        ),
        # The connection of a question migrated from the single-question fields (id "1"), and the field
        # the editor copies for each question it adds; the handle is drawn on that question's row.
        MessageTextInput(
            name=f"{_CONNECTION_PREFIX}1",
            display_name="Question 1",
            info="Connect a component to supply this question's text.",
            input_types=["Message"],
            show=False,
        ),
        HandleInput(
            name="structured_context",
            display_name="Structured Context",
            info=(
                "Optional: JSON to judge in place of Context, such as a record from another component. "
                "Use Context or Structured Context, not both."
            ),
            input_types=["Data", "JSON"],
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FloatInput(
            name="timeout",
            display_name="Timeout (seconds)",
            info="How long to wait for the decision model: more than 0 and at most 300 seconds.",
            value=60,
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(name="result", display_name="Decision Result", method="evaluate", info=_RESULT_INFO)]

    def _context(self) -> str | dict:
        """Context as text, or Structured Context as JSON; exactly one of them."""
        text = str(self.context or "").strip()
        structured = self.structured_context
        # An unconnected handle holds an empty string.
        connected = structured not in (None, "")
        if isinstance(structured, Data):
            structured = structured.data
        # Empty JSON gives the model nothing to judge.
        if not structured:
            structured = None
        if structured is None:
            if connected or not text:
                msg = (
                    "Structured Context is empty. Give the component it comes from at least one field, or use Context."
                    if connected
                    else "Enter a Context, or connect a Structured Context."
                )
                raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg)
            return self.context
        if text:
            msg = "Use Context or Structured Context, not both."
            raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg)
        return structured

    def _json_request(self, context: str | dict) -> DecisionBatchRequest:
        try:
            questions = json.loads(self.questions_json or "", object_pairs_hook=unique_json_object)
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            msg = f"Questions JSON must be a valid JSON object keyed by question name: {exc}"
            raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg) from None
        try:
            return DecisionBatchRequest(context=context, questions=questions)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            msg = f"Check Questions: {validation_summary(exc)}"
            raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg) from None

    def _connected_text(self, field: str) -> str | None:
        """The text a component connected to this hidden field sends, if any."""
        value = self._attributes.get(field)
        if value in (None, ""):
            return None
        return value.text if isinstance(value, Message) else str(value)

    def _question_fields(self, item, number: int) -> dict:
        """One question's fields, only those its Decision Type uses."""
        # A tweak can send anything here; the editor only offers these three types.
        kind = item.get("kind") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if kind not in _KINDS:
            msg = f"Pick a Decision Type for Question {number}: Choice, Noul or Score."
            raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg)
        kind = kind.lower()
        noul = kind == "noul"
        connected = {text: self._connected_text(field) for text, field in _connection_fields(item).items()}
        item = {**item, **{text: value for text, value in connected.items() if value is not None}}
        # A migrated field still holding the name of the global variable it was bound to; see _legacy_question.
        for field, variable in (item.get("global_variables") or {}).items():
            if (field == "question" or noul) and item.get(field) == variable:
                msg = (
                    f"Question {number}'s {_LEGACY_LABELS.get(field, field)} was read from the global variable "
                    f"{variable!r}, which question cards can't use. Type the text into the card, or clear it."
                )
                raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg)
        return {
            "kind": kind,
            "question": item.get("question"),
            "options": (item.get("options") or ()) if kind == "choice" else (),
            "levels": (item.get("levels") or ()) if kind == "score" else (),
            # Ignored for other types, so a value left from Noul never applies to them.
            "yes_description": (item.get("yes_description") or "") if noul else "",
            "no_description": (item.get("no_description") or "") if noul else "",
        }

    def _request(self):
        context = self._context()
        if self.question_mode == _JSON:
            return self._json_request(context)
        if self.question_mode != _FORM:
            msg = "Pick a Questions Mode: Form or JSON."
            raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg)
        items = self.questions
        if not isinstance(items, list) or not items:
            msg = "Add a question."
            raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg)
        if len(items) == 1:
            return decision_request(context=context, **self._question_fields(items[0], 1))
        questions = {}
        for number, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
            fields = self._question_fields(item, number)
            name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip() or f"q{number}"
            if name in questions:
                msg = f"Two questions are named {name!r}. Give each question a different Name."
                raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg)
            try:
                questions[name] = DecisionQuestion(**fields)
            except ValidationError as exc:
                msg = f"Question {number}: {configuration_summary(exc)}"
                raise DecisionConfigurationError(msg) from None
        try:
            return DecisionBatchRequest(context=context, questions=questions)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            raise DecisionConfigurationError(configuration_summary(exc)) from None

    def evaluate(self) -> Data:
        request = self._request()
        result = evaluate_decision(
            request,
            model=self.model,
            user_id=self.user_id,
            request_variables=request_variables_of(self),
            timeout=self.timeout,
        )
        self._token_usage = decision_token_usage(result)
        # Only what this decision returned and asked: no empty fields from the other types.
        data = Data(
            data={
                **result.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True),
                "request": request.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"context"}, exclude_defaults=True),
            }
        )
        self.status = data
        return data

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """Carry a node saved before the question list over to it, then show the saved mode's fields.

        Update rebuilds the node from the class and copies back only values whose field names match.
        """
        await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)
        template = new_frontend_node.get("template", {})
        saved = current_frontend_node.get("template", {})
        if (saved.get("questions") or {}).get("type") != "decision_questions":
            template["questions"]["value"] = [_legacy_question(saved)] if "question" in saved else []
            if "question" in saved:
                # The old fields keep their names as the migrated question's connections, so an edge
                # wired into one stays connected.
                for text, name in _connection_fields(template["questions"]["value"][0]).items():
                    template[name] = {
                        **deepcopy(template[f"{_CONNECTION_PREFIX}1"]),
                        "name": name,
                        "display_name": "Question 1" if text == "question" else _LEGACY_LABELS[text],
                    }
        for item in template["questions"]["value"]:
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("kind") == "Boolean":
                # The yes-or-no type was renamed Noul, the providers' own name for it.
                item["kind"] = "Noul"
        # Each question's connection fields live on the node; the class has only the one to copy.
        for item in template["questions"]["value"]:
            for name in _connection_fields(item).values() if isinstance(item, dict) else ():
                if name not in template and name in saved:
                    template[name] = deepcopy(saved[name])
        if template["question_mode"]["value"] not in {_FORM, _JSON}:
            template["question_mode"]["value"] = _FORM
        self._show_fields(template)
        return new_frontend_node

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dict, field_value, field_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
        config = handle_model_input_update(self, build_config, field_value, field_name)
        if field_name == "question_mode":
            config["question_mode"]["value"] = field_value
        self._show_fields(config)
        return config

    @staticmethod
    def _show_fields(config: dict) -> None:
        """Show the question list in Form mode and Questions JSON in JSON mode, keeping both values."""
        form = config.get("question_mode", {}).get("value", _FORM) != _JSON
        if "questions" in config:
            config["questions"]["show"] = form
        if "questions_json" in config:
            config["questions_json"]["show"] = not form
            config["questions_json"]["advanced"] = form


def _connection_fields(item: dict) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The hidden node fields a question's texts can be connected through, keyed by the text each supplies.

    Its question text's is the field it names or <prefix><id>; a Noul migrated from the old fields
    also names its What Yes Means and What No Means fields.
    """
    fields = {
        "question": item.get("input_field") or (f"{_CONNECTION_PREFIX}{item['id']}" if item.get("id") else None),
        "yes_description": item.get("yes_input_field"),
        "no_description": item.get("no_input_field"),
    }
    return {text: field for text, field in fields.items() if field}


def _legacy_question(saved: dict) -> dict:
    """The one question a node held in separate fields before the question list.

    A question card has no global variables, so a field bound to one keeps the variable's name and
    records the binding; the run refuses it until the card holds real text.
    """

    def value(name: str, default):
        return deepcopy((saved.get(name) or {}).get("value", default))

    bound = {
        name: value(name, "")
        for name in _LEGACY_LABELS
        if (saved.get(name) or {}).get("load_from_db") and value(name, "")
    }

    kind = value("kind", "Choice")
    kind = "Noul" if kind == "Boolean" else kind
    connections = {"input_field": "question"}
    if kind == "Noul":
        # What Yes Means and What No Means showed, and could be connected, only on a yes-or-no node.
        for answer in ("yes", "no"):
            if f"{answer}_description" in saved:
                connections[f"{answer}_input_field"] = f"{answer}_description"
    options = value("candidates", _NEW_QUESTION["options"])
    levels = value("levels", _NEW_QUESTION["levels"])
    if "levels" not in saved and kind == "Score":
        # Older Score nodes stored their rubric in the shared candidates field.
        options, levels = deepcopy(_NEW_QUESTION["options"]), options
    return {
        **deepcopy(_NEW_QUESTION),
        "id": "1",
        **connections,
        "kind": kind,
        "question": value("question", ""),
        "options": options,
        "levels": levels,
        "yes_description": value("yes_description", ""),
        "no_description": value("no_description", ""),
        **({"global_variables": bound} if bound else {}),
    }

from collections.abc import Generator
from typing import Any

import orjson
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.helpers.data import safe_convert
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput, DropdownInput, HandleInput, MessageTextInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.dataframe import DataFrame
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.schema.properties import Source
from lfx.template.field.base import Output
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)


class ChatOutput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Output"
    description = "Display a chat message in the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Inputs",
            info="Message to be passed as output.",
            input_types=["Data", "JSON", "DataFrame", "Table", "Message"],
            required=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
            advanced=True,
            info="Type of sender.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="data_template",
            display_name="Data Template",
            value="{text}",
            advanced=True,
            info="Template to convert Data to Text. If left empty, it will be dynamically set to the Data's text key.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="clean_data",
            display_name="Basic Clean Data",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
            info="Whether to clean data before converting to string.",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Output Message",
            name="message",
            method="message_response",
        ),
    ]

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) and not self.is_connected_to_chat_input():
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
            # Preserve existing session_id from the incoming message if it exists
            existing_session_id = message.session_id
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
            existing_session_id = None

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        # Preserve session_id from incoming message, or use component/graph session_id
        message.session_id = (
            self.session_id or existing_session_id or (self.graph.session_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None) or ""
        )
        message.context_id = self.context_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        # Store message if needed
        if message.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Set accumulated token usage from all upstream LLM vertices.
        # This must happen AFTER send_message() because streaming captures
        # usage from chunks and would overwrite accumulated totals.
        if hasattr(self, "_vertex") and self._vertex is not None:
            accumulated_usage = self._vertex._accumulate_upstream_token_usage()  # noqa: SLF001
            if accumulated_usage:
                message.properties.usage = accumulated_usage
                if self.should_store_message and message.get_id():
                    message = await self._update_stored_message(message)
                    await self._send_message_event(message, id_=message.get_id())

        self.status = message
        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value, clean_data=clean_data)

context_id.info: The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.
context_id.name: context_id

data_template.info: Template to convert Data to Text. If left empty, it will be dynamically set to the Data's text key.
data_template.name: data_template

input_value.info: Message to be passed as output.
input_value.name: input_value

session_id.info: The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.
session_id.name: session_id

should_store_message.info: Store the message in the history.
should_store_message.name: should_store_message

# 🏷️ Message Classifier

Classifies each message as a **Question**, **Bug report**, **Feature request**, or **Billing** with a **decision model**, which returns a probability for every category instead of generated text. The **Chat Output** shows the full result, so you can see how sure the model is.

## Setup
1. Open **Model Providers**, choose a provider that offers decision models, and save its API key. Saving sends one small, billed check.
2. In the **Decision Model** component, check that **Decision Model** names a model from that provider, and pick one if it doesn't.

## Use
1. Open the **Playground**.
2. Send a message, such as `The export button does nothing when I click it.`
3. Read the result: `probabilities` has one entry per category **ID**, and they add up to 1.

## Tune it
- Edit the **Options** table to change the categories. **ID** is the key in the result, **Label** is the name the model reads, and **Description** says when the category applies.
- Set **Decision Type** to **Boolean** for a yes or no question, or **Score** to place the message on ordered levels.
- To route on the answer instead of reading it, use a **Smart Router** in **Decision Model** mode, as in the **Support Ticket Routing** template.

description: Classify a message with a decision model and see the probability of every category.
name: Message Classifier
